test_SubstrateTestCase: test the SubstrateTestCase base class for validating substrate environments
test_assert_step_matches_specs: test the assert_step_matches_specs method to verify env actions, rewards, and observations match their specs
test_env_action_spec: test that an environment's action spec is correctly defined and actions are accepted
test_env_reward_spec: test that an environment's reward spec matches the actual reward values returned
test_env_observation_spec: test that an environment's observation spec keys and values match the actual observations
